subject: rpc_health_samples
reason: Retention prune of an operational telemetry table that is not covered by any study archive but is read without a time bound by the W4.3 evidence query.

restoreVerification.method: restored into a scratch database created by sudo-postgres, then compared md5(string_agg(row::text ORDER BY id)) against the source over the identical observed_at window

consumers.runtimeReadsBoundedTo: 6-16 minutes (paper executor, store, recovery, live-pilot guard, dashboard, canary plan)
unboundedReaders: scripts/paper-performance-audit.mjs accepts an arbitrary [from, asOf] window

limitations: The archive directory is on the same host and disk as the source database and is not tracked by Git.
Pruning the live table changes the results of the W4.3 unbounded queries when re-run against conc_liq; the archive is then the only source that reproduces the published figures.
